igdb.title: IGDB game data
igdb.description: Players pick the games they play from a search. With IGDB credentials the search covers every game, with covers; without them, search uses Wikidata.
igdb.howToStep1: Create a Twitch account and turn on Two-Factor Authentication.
igdb.howToStep2: Register an app in the Twitch Developer Console. Redirect URL: http://localhost. Client Type: Confidential.
igdb.howToStep3: Open the app, press Manage, and copy the Client ID.
igdb.howToStep4: Press New Secret and copy the Client Secret.
igdb.howToStep5: Paste both here, press Save, then Test connection.
igdb.secretSetPlaceholder: Saved. Enter a new secret to replace it
igdb.secretHelper: Write-only: the saved secret is never shown.
igdb.envOverride: IGDB_CLIENT_ID and IGDB_CLIENT_SECRET are set in the environment, and take precedence over this form.

packs.hint: A pack is a file describing one game — a name, a tile and how a result is reported. It contains no code and runs on a module above.

reload.body: Reload the page to load or unload the module's code.

confirm.title: Enable {{name}}?
confirm.warning: It runs inside Auto Tournament's server with full access to your database, files and secrets, and inside the browser of every admin and player who opens a page it draws, with their permissions. Auto Tournament does not review or sandbox code modules. Enable it only if you trust its author as much as you trust this platform.

failure.badEntry: its code is not served from {{prefix}}
failure.noClientApi: it declares no client API range; this platform provides {{platform}}
failure.badClientApi: its client API range “{{range}}” is not a semver range
failure.outOfRange: built for client API {{range}}; this platform provides {{platform}}
failure.httpError: its code could not be fetched (HTTP {{status}})
failure.notJavaScript: its code is served as {{contentType}}, not JavaScript
failure.timeout: its code did not load within {{seconds}} seconds
failure.sharedFailed: the platform could not share its packages with it: {{error}}
failure.badExport: its code is not a module definition: {{detail}}
failure.idMismatch: its code calls itself “{{id}}”, but it is installed as “{{expected}}”

catalog.title: Games
catalog.hint: Every game this instance runs, and the ones you can add. Game packs are data; code modules are signed by Auto Tournament. Both install with one click, and the ones marked “In this image” need no network.
catalog.allInstalled: Everything in the catalog is installed.
catalog.noneInstalled: No games are installed yet. Install the ones you want to run tournaments for — players pick from these.
catalog.loadFailed: Could not read the game catalog: {{reason}}

feed.cache: Showing the last catalog this instance saw ({{reason}}). Games in this image still install without a network.
feed.none: The online catalog could not be reached ({{reason}}). Showing the games inside this image; they install without a network.
feed.cacheRefreshing: Showing the catalog from {{time}} while the online catalog loads.
feed.noneRefreshing: Loading the online catalog… Meanwhile these are the games inside this image; they install without a network.

reason.timeout: it did not answer in time

reason.newer_schema: it is written for a newer Auto Tournament
